0.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_TALK_ENTRANCEMAN_000_001
0.description: Thank you for your assistance. Allow me to escort you to the pâtisserie when ready. Should you wish, I would be glad to offer my advice as a pâtissier ahead of your foray.
0.translation_description: Grazie per il tuo aiuto. Quando vuoi, ti accompagnerò alla pasticceria. Se ti va, prima della tua visita posso darti qualche consiglio da pasticciere.

6.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_A2_000_001
6.description: As part of a matched party.

9.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_TALK_SYSTEM_000_010
9.description: Head to the pâtisserie with a matched party?
9.translation_description: Vuoi raggiungere la pasticceria con un gruppo abbinato?

10.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_TALK_SYSTEM_000_015
10.description: Head to the pâtisserie with your current party?
10.translation_description: Vuoi raggiungere la pasticceria con il tuo gruppo attuale?

12.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_A3_000_001
12.description: How many people can enter the pâtisserie?
12.translation_description: Quante persone possono entrare nella pasticceria?

13.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_A3_000_002
13.description: What should I expect to find?

14.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_A3_000_003
14.description: What can be done about the mammets?
14.translation_description: Come si possono fermare i mammets?

16.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_TALK_ENTRANCEMAN_000_020
16.description: The mammets of the pâtisserie consider all who set foot within its halls to be intruders. To limit injury and incident, I recommend entering as a group of no more than four capable individuals.
16.translation_description: I mammets della pasticceria considerano intrusi tutti coloro che varcano la soglia. Per ridurre il rischio di incidenti e infortuni, consiglio di entrare in gruppi di non più di quattro persone capaci.

17.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_SYSTEM_000_021
17.description: The pâtisserie is a light party instance for a party of one to four players. There are no class, job, or level requirements for participation.
17.translation_description: La pasticceria è un’istanza per gruppi leggeri da uno a quattro giocatori. Non ci sono requisiti di classe, job o livello.

18.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_SYSTEM_000_022
18.description: Parties that register for the instance with less than four members can choose to enter with their current party, or choose to fill their party automatically via the matching system.
18.translation_description: I gruppi di meno di quattro persone possono entrare con i membri attuali oppure usare il sistema di abbinamento per completare automaticamente il gruppo.

19.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_TALK_ENTRANCEMAN_000_0030
19.description: Decorate as many cakes as possible, while avoiding interference from the rampaging mammets. Kupka Kupp will take charge of recipe selection and direct your hand accordingly.
19.translation_description: Decora più torte che puoi evitando i mammets impazziti. Kupka Kupp sceglierà le ricette e ti guiderà nel lavoro.

20.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_TALK_ENTRANCEMAN_000_0031
20.description: It would seem that the mere sight of completed cakes drives the mammets into a further frenzy. Though they appear to return to a more docile state once all intruders have left the pâtisserie, pray take care while you remain within.
20.translation_description: A quanto pare, la sola vista delle torte finite fa infuriare ancora di più i mammets. Sembrano tornare docili quando tutti gli intrusi lasciano la pasticceria, ma fai attenzione finché sei lì.

21.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_SYSTEM_000_032
21.description: Carry the ingredients requested by Kupka Kupp to the cake stands and artfully decorate as many giant cakes as possible within the time limit. Once a cake is complete, you will be able to start work on the next.
21.translation_description: Porta gli ingredienti richiesti da Kupka Kupp ai banchi da pasticceria e decora con cura più torte giganti che puoi entro il tempo limite. Quando ne completi una, potrai iniziare la successiva.

22.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_SYSTEM_000_033
22.description: The more cakes that reach completion, the more frenzied the mammets will grow, causing them to move faster.
22.translation_description: Più torte completerai, più i mammets si infurieranno e si muoveranno velocemente.

23.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_TALK_ENTRANCEMAN_000_0040
23.description: There is a way to temporarily stop the mammets in their tracks. This maintenance whistle from the Goldsmiths' Guild causes the mammets to cease all activity, baking or otherwise.
23.translation_description: C’è un modo per fermare temporaneamente i mammets. Questo fischietto di manutenzione della Gilda degli Orafi li blocca, interrompendo ogni attività, pasticceria compresa.

24.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_TALK_ENTRANCEMAN_000_0041
24.description: Sounding it correctly requires a moment of intense concentration, so ensure to use it at the optimal moment to secure a route to the cake.
24.translation_description: Per suonarlo correttamente serve un momento di intensa concentrazione: usalo nel momento giusto per aprirti la strada verso le torte.

25.name: TEXT_FESVLT2026ENTRANCE_00938_SYSTEM_000_042
25.description: The duty action <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Bake: Off<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can only be used when your hands are free and unencumbered by ingredients. It will temporarily render any mammet within range unable to move.
25.translation_description: L’azione speciale <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Forno: spento!<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si può usare solo quando hai le mani libere e non porti ingredienti. Blocca temporaneamente i mammets nel raggio d’azione.
